deferred_migration.note: Evidence only; actual key replacement/reset is explicitly unsupported. ReEncrypt does not prove completed migration.

normalization: The native administrative IAM user is represented by a local root; the scoped AssumeRole session policies and explicit KMS role grants are unchanged.
Native key UUID and queue URL are bound to values returned by local SDK operations. Customer-supplied key identifier forms remain distinct.
Create/update/describe assertions preserve selected semantic fields; native physical SizeBytes and eventual counters, UUIDs and wall-clock processing timestamps are not compared.
Fast changing KMS policies exhibited propagation carryover; service denial cases use the settled matrix.
Omitted asynchronous key-reset/migration calls are explicitly unsupported locally. Re-enabling the same key supplies the enabled precondition for later independent caller-admission cases.
Replay readiness advances one deterministic local minute, not the measured AWS processing latency. Positive/negative receipt observations use native final replay outcomes.
